description: Published 0.1.0-alpha.1 source. Retain until an evidence-backed baseline promotion is explicitly justified.
exceptionReason: 2026-09-21: user explicitly accepted approximately 7% extra allocation and 12% extra update latency for themed updates for now. Across 11-sample paired benchmarks, core list update allocations improved by 5.02% (32 MB saved) and virtualized by 5.84%, while mount allocations and times improved across all scenarios. The residual 6.45% themed allocation overhead reflects the verified cost of supporting rich native button content via ButtonContentPresenter (ca428c7) and accessible CheckBox styling (800e1b8). All other budgets remain unchanged.
